breaking_news.headline: CBS' Bari Weiss overhauls '60 Minutes,' fires top producer and reporters
breaking_news.summary: The new head of CBS News is flexing her muscles at the network's most storied news program: "60 Minutes." We look at the upheaval.

breaking_news.headline: Here's how we're coping with high gas prices, according to Costco and Walmart
breaking_news.summary: Sky-high gas prices have drivers going out of their way for discounts at the pump. Oil executives warn that even higher prices might be on the horizon.

breaking_news.headline: United Airlines flight to Spain pulls U-turn, apparently over Bluetooth device name
breaking_news.summary: The flight to Palma de Mallorca diverted back to Newark late on Saturday. Air traffic audio and social media posts indicate an onboard Bluetooth device raised security concerns.

breaking_news.headline: One by one, U.S. civil rights agency dismantles tools to fight discrimination
breaking_news.summary: The EEOC is seeking to overturn rules created decades ago to tackle discrimination in employment. The Trump administration says those rules have led to more discrimination —against white people.

breaking_news.headline: Remote work -- not AI -- has sidelined recent college graduates, research finds
breaking_news.summary: Research from the New York Fed finds that younger college graduates have been sidelined by remote work in recent years, as companies may be reluctant to hire those needing more training and mentoring.

breaking_news.headline: AI giant Anthropic prepares to sell stock to the public; files preliminary IPO paperwork
breaking_news.summary: The Anthropic IPO, and those of other AI-related firms like OpenAI, could be among the biggest in U.S. history.

breaking_news.headline: DOJ is investigating former congressman George Santos for insider trading on Kalshi
breaking_news.summary: The disgraced former congressman allegedly bet on whether he would appear at the State of the Union address, prompting federal investigations.

breaking_news.headline: Thieves are targeting the world's copper. This phone company is fighting back
breaking_news.summary: The value of copper is rising, and thieves can make money by stripping it from phone poles, streetlights and EV chargers. But those thefts cost the rest of us.

breaking_news.headline: Trump-backed candidate in Iowa loses primary
breaking_news.summary: Randy Feenstra's defeat could prove to be a case of the president's political instincts being off.

breaking_news.headline: Celine Dion 'heartbroken' by death of Beauty and the Beast singer Peabo Bryson
breaking_news.summary: Bryson was best known as the voice behind Disney songs like A Whole New World and Beauty and the Beast.

breaking_news.headline: Eight killed after drone hits bus in Russian-occupied part of Ukraine
breaking_news.summary: The bus was hit in the eastern Donetsk region, an official says.

breaking_news.headline: Foreign nationals among at least 21 killed in Delhi fire
breaking_news.summary: Many victims were South Asians who had travelled to India for treatment or to accompany relatives.

breaking_news.headline: Shell pumped oil through Nigeria pipeline for years despite pollution evidence, documents show
breaking_news.summary: The oil giant says the documents ignore the critical context of the complex operating environment at the time.

breaking_news.headline: Ukrainian drones hit St Petersburg as Putin's flagship economic forum opens
breaking_news.summary: Several long-range drones struck oil storage facilities near the city, days before Vladimir Putin is due to address the event.

breaking_news.headline: One killed and dozens injured in Iranian drone strikes on Kuwait airport
breaking_news.summary: Iran says the attack on Kuwait was in retaliation for earlier US strikes on an Iranian oil tanker and island.

breaking_news.headline: Publishers in UK can opt out of Google AI search results
breaking_news.summary: The Competition and Markets Authority says it would put publishers "in a stronger position to negotiate content deals with Google".

breaking_news.headline: Microsoft testing wearable AI gadget aimed at office workers
breaking_news.summary: The company said its own workers are testing a "wearable access badge" and a desktop device.

breaking_news.headline: How 'confused' AI rollout hurts firms and baffles staff
breaking_news.summary: Some firms are putting pressure on staff to use AI, but have not thought through their AI rollout.

breaking_news.headline: Lloyds, Halifax and Bank of Scotland back after online banking outage
breaking_news.summary: "We're aware some customers are having issues with our app and online banking. We're really sorry about this," Lloyds Bank posted on X.

breaking_news.headline: Universal park officially named as government pledges £1.3bn
breaking_news.summary: The government's contribution is going towards upgrading local infrastructure and transport links.
